title: improvements
description: Recource Pack i created for fun and to fix some issues like tools being to big
body:
Recource Pack i created for fun and to fix some issues like tools being to big.
This applyes for all materials and tools including :
  -hoes
![diamond hoe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eed252fad488866f9c5a271c9d9217b9561962e2.png)
  -shovels
![diamond shovel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dcf0106a853329dac6ebb4345c0ce8789ffd600.png)
  -axes
![diamond axe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/042adc430724ebdb6370d4a775b13b54b4b71309.png)
  -pickaxes
![diamond pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35fa373f500e6f2571f2318241faec493b4830e7.png)
  -swords
![diamond sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5601bea6ede5394076d70b75918c663c9ae50938.png)
  -bow
![bow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7499582bd35d787c6dc91e60c98a119a19534e4e.png)
  -crossbow
![crossbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d13ec45286be2de6b4860c5def8a33c4e330518.png)

this also applyes to all athor not so common tools like:
  -flint and steel
![flint and steel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bedbc8d60be3ef04c4db314852705ac551cc448c_0.webp)
  -and all bucket types for example
  ![pufferfish bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03e04eda0960f88d6fd40c9b6775a9497133e72c.png)
   or axolotl bucket
![axolotl bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d254bfd133495c4ebb3207b89d41b998844f356.png)

theres also armor:
![diamond helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28794bc5da50946096b6fbff7585dc99155eea33.png)
![diamond chest plate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4ae31811629c58cbe26beb3b5aa0342211e3411.png)![diamond leggins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0409803ba21f4781e2289a1390f75bd64cf646a.png)![diamond boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9414dcdd93babb6feb4d120c6170d1f776ebb763.png)

this was so much fun for me to make and i hope you'll enjoy it
